meaning.en: A person or animal that is extremely thin, often to the point that their bones appear clearly visible.
meaning.zh: 一個瘦骨嶙峋的人或動物；瘦得全身骨頭清晰可見，彷彿只剩下皮和骨頭。
naturalZh: 一個瘦骨嶙峋的人或動物

benefits.titleEn: It Communicates a Strong Degree Clearly
benefits.en: The idiomatic version expresses a much more serious degree of thinness.
benefits.zh: 慣用語版本表達的消瘦程度遠比 very thin 嚴重。

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Memorable Visual Image
benefits.en: It Creates a Memorable Visual Image

benefits.titleEn: It Can Express Concern or Shock
benefits.en: The expression communicates not only appearance but also the speaker’s emotional reaction.
benefits.zh: 這個表達不只描述外表，也傳達說話者的情緒反應。

benefits.en: The expression is useful in before-and-after descriptions.
benefits.zh: 這個表達適合用於前後狀況對比。

benefits.en: The sentence makes the harmful result vivid.
benefits.zh: 句子生動地呈現了疏忽照顧造成的嚴重後果。

benefits.en: An idiom is not automatically better than a plain description. When speaking directly to someone or writing formally, a neutral description may be kinder and more accurate.
benefits.zh: 慣用語並不一定比直接描述更好。 當面對別人說話或撰寫正式內容時，中性描述可能會更有禮貌和更準確。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Development; Exact First Use Unknown
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切首次用法不明

history.en: The expression does not appear to come from one known event or inventor. A historical slang reference records related wording such as bedfull of bones in 1621. Charles Dickens later used the description “little bag o’ bones” in Oliver Twist, published in 1838. This is an early documented literary example, not proof that Dickens created the expression.
history.zh: 這個表達似乎並非源自一件可以確認的事件或某一位創作者。 歷史俚語資料記錄了1621年出現的相關說法 bedfull of bones。 Charles Dickens 後來在1838年出版的《孤雛淚》中使用了 “little bag o’ bones” 這個描述。 這是較早期的文學記錄，但不能證明 Dickens 創造了這個表達。

history.en: The physical image is direct: if a person or animal has lost a great deal of weight, the body may appear to contain bones with very little flesh around them. Speakers gradually used this picture as a fixed description of extreme thinness.
history.zh: 這個身體意象十分直接：如果一個人或動物大幅消瘦，身體看起來便可能只剩下骨頭，周圍幾乎沒有肌肉。 說話者逐漸把這個畫面固定用作描述極度消瘦。

origin.memoryEn: Imagine a body with so little flesh that it seems to be only a bag holding bones.
origin.memoryZh: 想像一個幾乎沒有肌肉的身體，彷彿只是一個裝着骨頭的袋。

rules.en: A is part of the fixed noun phrase.
rules.zh: A 是固定名詞短語的一部分。

rules.titleZh: 規則二：bones 必須使用複數
rules.en: The image is of a body containing many bones.
rules.zh: 這個意象是一個身體內包含多塊骨頭。

rules.titleEn: Use It Only for Extreme Thinness
rules.titleZh: 規則四：只用於極度消瘦
rules.en: The idiom is much stronger than slim or thin.
rules.zh: 那隻獲救的狗瘦得每根肋骨都清晰可見。 這個慣用語的程度遠強於 slim 或 thin。

examples.en: The rescued dog was a bag of bones.

rules.titleEn: People and Animals Are Both Possible
rules.titleZh: 規則五：人和動物都可以使用
rules.en: People and Animals Are Both Possible
rules.zh: 病後，他看起來瘦得只剩皮包骨。 那匹獲救的馬瘦骨嶙峋。

examples.en: The rescued horse was a bag of bones.

rules.titleEn: Preserve the Cause When It Matters
rules.titleZh: 規則六：在重要時保留原因
rules.en: The weak answer removes the cause supplied by the source.
rules.zh: 較弱的答案刪除了原句提供的原因。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：保留隨時間出現的變化
rules.en: Do not remove the contrast between his earlier and later condition.
rules.zh: 不要刪除他以前和後來狀況之間的對比。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Add a Second Explanation
rules.titleZh: 規則八：不要再次解釋相同意思
rules.en: The second part largely repeats the meaning of the idiom. The visible ribs provide evidence that licenses the idiom rather than repeating it afterwards.
rules.zh: 後半部分大致上重複了慣用語的意思。 肋骨清晰可見是支持使用這個慣用語的證據，而不是在慣用語之後再次解釋。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It as a Medical Diagnosis
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把它當作醫療診斷
rules.en: The idiom is not precise clinical language.
rules.zh: 這個慣用語並不是準確的臨床用語。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：避免直接侮辱別人
rules.zh: 他的家人十分擔心，因為他病後瘦得只剩皮包骨。

rules.titleEn: Distinguish “A Bag of Bones” from Skin and
rules.en: Both expressions can describe extreme thinness, but they are grammatically different. Every answer in this exercise must use a bag of bones.
rules.zh: 分辨 a bag of bones 和 skin and bones 兩者都可以描述極度消瘦，但文法結構不同。 本練習的所有答案都必須使用 a bag of bones。

rules.titleZh: 規則十二：避免字面語境
rules.en: The neglected horse had become a bag of bones.
rules.zh: 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。
